s1.quote: Pillaarsteen … Diving is particularly good at around 30-40m depth. … This area may be effected by surge when there are swells from the southwest.

s2.quote: Pillarsteen … Avg. Depth: 18m; Max Depth: 40m … This dive is still quite good when other places have too much current, but can be prone to swell.

summary.text: A Komodo reef slope off Padar with boulders, caves and swim-throughs, carpeted in soft corals and patrolled by fusiliers, sharks and turtles. Useful when other sites run hard current, but can surge in swell.

s1.quote: The Lighthouse, located off the point of Gili Lawa Laut, is a drift dive for the more experienced diver. … Avg. Depth: 15m; Max Depth: 35m

s2.quote: Lighthouse … There are big table corals, whip corals, soft corals, and sandy areas in the reef.

highlights.text: Table, whip and soft corals on a sloping reef

summary.text: A drift-style reef off Gili Lawa Laut in northern Komodo, with two pinnacles on a sloping reef and table corals, whip corals and white-tip sharks. Operators rate it for more experienced divers.

s1.quote: Gindang … Generally unaffected by current, this is best dived at a nice slow relaxed pace to better locate the hidden treasures within!
The dives at Secret Bay are very shallow - no more than 10 metres during high tide - and visibility is varies between 5 metres - low tide - up to 15m.

s2.quote: Secret Bay … Currents Very gentle Depth (m) 3 - 10 … frogfish, nudibranch, seahorses, yellow-margin moray eels, ghost pipefish and dragonets can be seen

hazards.text: Visibility drops at low tide or if silt is kicked up

summary.text: A very shallow muck site beside Gilimanuk harbour on Bali's west tip. Fine black volcanic sand and rubble, not coral, hold frogfish, ghost pipefish and dragonets; best at high tide when visibility is better.

s1.quote: Temple Wall / Pura Tembok (the Maze, Temple Garden) Trip Time: ±10 minutes Current: Slight to strong … The wall bottom ranges from 16 to 35 m

s2.quote: Temple Wall … Currents are usually mild but the depth makes it a dive for experienced divers with solid buoyancy and good air management. Depth: 18 – 35 m

highlights.text: Sponges, gorgonians and soft corals on the wall
Crustaceans and large gorgonians on the deep section

summary.text: A boat dive in Pemuteran Bay: a wall beneath the underwater temple statues, dropping to around 35 m and covered in sponges, gorgonians and soft corals. Depth and occasional current make it one for experienced divers.

s1.quote: Kebun Batu (The Rock Garden)& Karang Lestari (Biorock) Trip Time: ±5mins Current: Rarely Brief: Artificial Reef project, max. 18 m depth plenty of critters and small fish, excellent for night dives

highlights.text: Critters and small fish; good night dive

s1.quote: Boga Wreck … The 50-meter-long ship is currently a home for fish and coral. You can find it at a depth of 14 meters to 32 meters for the deepest part.

s2.quote: Boga Wreck … Depth range 18–40 m Access Shore … Experience level Advanced … known for batfish, trevally, barracuda, moray eels, and lionfish

summary.text: A purpose-sunk wreck at Kubu, just north of Tulamben, reached from the beach. It lies at roughly 14-40 m depending on the part and the guide, so it is rated advanced; fish and coral now cover the hull.
